REJECT

The patch replaces the fully qualified `CodeHealth.Core.Classification.SourceClassifier` with a bare `SourceClassifier` but adds no `using CodeHealth.Core.Classification;`, so unless the file already imports that namespace (the original fully qualified call suggests it doesn't), the build fails with CS0103 and warnings-as-errors makes that fatal. I could not open the file in this environment, so this rests on the diff alone.
